instruction: Navigate to the Liam name detail page on babycenter.com

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to the Liam name detail page on babycenter.com. Uses regex pattern matching to verify navigation to the Liam name detail page. This avoids hardcoding specific URL IDs which may not be verifiable. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'babycenter.com/baby-names/details/liam-' which is the standard format for name detail pages on this site.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing Chrome getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and existing metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match). No new functions needed. Pattern matches the babycenter.com URL structure for name detail pages.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction and evaluator are semantically aligned. The instruction asks to 'Navigate to the Liam name detail page on babycenter.com', and the evaluator correctly verifies this by checking if the active URL matches the pattern 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/liam-'.
Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match uses regex pattern matching to verify the URL structure, which will correctly identify navigation to Liam's detail page.

Pattern is accurate: The regex pattern 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/liam-' correctly matches babycenter.com's URL structure for the Liam name detail page (the trailing dash allows for URL variations like 'liam-1234' or 'liam-boys-name').
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction - that the user navigated to Liam's name detail page on babycenter.com.
